facts.fact: Arrêté n° 007/24/MENTD/CAB of 10 September 2024 sets the conditions under which public bodies may access and share data of the Registre social des personnes et des ménages: ANID supplies the data through personalised accounts on the RSPM platform after a request, a signed ANID convention and, for personal data, IPDCP authorisation; it names no body that has been connected.
